name: M5_CONFIRMED_PIVOT_BREAK_RETEST_V1
cohort: 26 symbols from the frozen 61-event baseline, not its trigger timestamps

atr.value: last M5 ATR before breakout, frozen

retest.reaction: touch zone and close back on breakout side of pivot
retest.cancel: close beyond opposite outer edge of retest zone

stop: extreme of all post-break waiting M5 bars through reaction, plus 0.10 frozen ATR; rounded away from entry
target: impulse extreme from breakout through candle BEFORE reaction, known at reaction close; rounded conservatively
entry_band: reaction close +/- 0.25 frozen ATR, financial gate may narrow it
pending_entry_cancel: SL or TP touched after reaction and before delayed entry cancels attempt
outcomes: M1 after entry only, SL first if same-minute ambiguity, adverse gap priced at opening
finance: same public contract parameters and config/default.toml as frozen baseline; bank1 risk<=10% RR>=1 floor10x cap20x fee0.06% per side, synthetic spread0.02%, slippage max0.02% or2ticks, funding0
comparison: all day and a common mature cohort: signals <= price_cutoff-4h; independent overlapping plans, no wallet simulation
status: Exploratory single-day protocol fixed before running outcomes; no parameter sweep; production unchanged
